question: What is the per-file download cap per IP on gigafile.nu (the record says 2 GB/day, 5 downloads/day of the same file), and are the 5 to 150 day retention periods all free?
why: Neither the main page nor the support page states a daily download cap; the 150-day maximum is stated on the free pages but a paid-plan tie is not excluded. The record's egress.terms and limits[0] still carry the 2 GB/day figure unverified.
